svg.title: Typical protein / antibody screening workflow
svg.desc: Six flat, editable experimental scenes: DNA construction, expression and purification, binding screening, characterization, cell function and model feedback.

text.tspan: Flat experimental schematics: the tools, inputs and suppliers behind each step
Linked results → next design → next experiment
Automation + data orchestration span every step
Representative experiments, not a fixed protocol. Assays may run in parallel. LC-MS is shown for analytical QC.
*Waters Biosciences is the former BD Biosciences portfolio. Flat schematics and text are editable; supplier examples and sources: workflow/SOURCES.md.
